name: principalwp-toolkit
description: Principal WP's Claude Code tools in one install: htmlizer (interactive local HTML review pages with feedback back into the session), wp-prototype (clickable single-file WordPress admin mockups), writing-for-llms and anti-ai-slop (write and sharpen skills, agents, and prose), and the WordPress Starter Pipeline (one component change to a reviewed, tested PR through gated agent phases).
